title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode5 To Bring Hope

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That was amazing!
She's totally just like a real idol!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Her aura was blinding...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wouldn't worry about Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, why not...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
She has a lot going on right now...
She isn't really in a place where she can enjoy an idol show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I had tons of fun♪
You never get to see a show from this close!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You do like idols a lot, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I do♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all for lending me a hand today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun performing in front of them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But we didn't really do anything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, we didn't. You were the one who sang for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you all called them over for me, remember? So, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Umm... I'm going to do my stretches over there! It's important to cool down after a show.
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mizuki and the others said that they all had fun...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But I wasn't able to make everyone smile from the bottoms of their hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (My singing and dancing weren't enough...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They did say their worries aren't so easy to resolve, I guess.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We were lucky enough to meet, so I want to help them smile as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Their problems may be difficult to solve.
They may be full of pain and suffering.
But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm sure that you'll be able to spread hope to them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because you've been growing all this time alongside girls who have never given up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've made my decision. I want to keep doing what I can for them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Umm... You said that you're gonna put on another show for us, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is this one going to be different somehow...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Probably, right?
But I thought the one she just did was pretty good.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You want to know more about them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I want to put on a show which really resonates with them, so I'd like for you to tell me more about them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, but...!
Only what you're comfortable telling me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Which is why they're trying to produce songs which can save people.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. In actuality, the songs Kanade and the others produce feel very warm.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I also like them.
They make my heart feel warm and cozy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Warm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whenever something is bothering them, what do you all usually do for them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I...
Try to be by their side. I think that's mostly it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All of them, especially Mafuyu, carry pain that's difficult to put into words.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I just want to be by their side, and have them share their pain with me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Now I see...
This is what they meant by “waiting”...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All to be by their sides whenever they come to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They all carry the sort of pain that you can't put into words.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (If that's the case, then I also want to support them from by their sides.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I want to fill their hearts with as much warmth as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This song...
She sang it during her earlier show too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, but it's arranged a little differently...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For some reason, it feels...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Warm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (What a wonderful song...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that “I” was able to connect with them...)
